## Investigation

What standard MIDI messages does the offline-connected Seaboard emit, and is
its expressive behaviour consistent with MPE?

::: {.manual-prereq title="Require an offline-recognized controller"}

Confirm that the Stage 2 record is `confirmed`. Keep the Mac offline, use the
same USB connection, and do not open Dashboard or change a setting. This page
may run only while the active intention specification still covers passive MIDI
observation.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Select a passive MIDI observer"}

Choose a MIDI event monitor that only listens to the Seaboard input. Record its
name and version in a new observation record:

```bash
cp evidence/templates/midi-mpe-observation.yml evidence/records/seaboard-block-01-midi-mpe.yml
```

Do not send MIDI or SysEx messages to the device in this stage.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Perform one fixed gesture set"}

For each gesture, record message families, channels, and whether you observed
the expected change: one note; two simultaneous notes; pressure on one held
note; lateral movement of one held note; and vertical movement of one held
note. Preserve a short redacted event log only if it contains no unrelated MIDI
traffic.

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Evaluate MIDI and MPE evidence"}

Confirm ordinary MIDI only when note-on and note-off events were observed.
Confirm MPE only when the record contains evidence of independently expressive
per-note behaviour and the observer/method is named. Otherwise retain
`unknown`—a melodic response alone is not sufficient evidence for MPE.

:::
